subject: general
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

A battle or anything involving or causing much bloodshed
solution:
Here the correct answer is **Sanguinary.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words is** option 2: "Sanguinary."**
 
• **Sanguinary**: This word is an **adjective **that describes something related to or characterized by bloodshed or violence. It specifically refers to events, actions, or situations that involve or cause much bloodshed. (बहुत अधिक रक्तपात होने या कारण बनने वाला)
 
 
• Example: "The **sanguinary **battle lasted for days, leaving behind a trail of destruction and loss of life."
 
 
 
• Therefore, option 2, "Sanguinary," is the correct answer as it accurately represents a battle or anything involving or causing much bloodshed.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Now let's explore the other options and their meanings:

 

 
• **Autocracy**: A system of government by one person with absolute power (एक व्यक्ति द्वारा निरपेक्ष सत्ता के साथ शासन की व्यवस्था)

 
 
• **Example**: In an autocracy, the king made all the decisions without consulting his subjects 
 
 
 
• **Ineffable**: Too great or extreme to be expressed or described in words (शब्दों में व्यक्त या वर्णित करने के लिए अत्यधिक महान या चरम)
 
 
• **Example**: The beauty of the sunset was ineffable, leaving everyone speechless.
 
 
 
• **Redtapism**: Excessive adherence to rules and formalities, especially in public business (विशेषकर सार्वजनिक व्यापार में, नियमों और औपचारिकताओं का अत्यधिक पालन)
 
 
• **Example**: The new policy was delayed due to redtapism in the department.
